answers.reason: As a member of the central university leadership, the vice president for studies is permitted to participate in central university bodies like the senate.
Because funding and study programmes are treated as parts of one university-wide plan, the vice president for studies is involved in the central budget planning round.
Holders of a higher office may take part in the bodies below their level, and appointments are part of the university-wide plan affecting teaching.
Holders of a higher office may take part in bodies below their level, and the faculty council decides on study regulations which fall under the vice president's university-wide responsibility.
The vice president holds a higher office and is directly responsible for degree programmes and quality of teaching across the university.
The vice president holds a higher office than the faculty level and is responsible for examinations across the university.
Because those with a higher office may take part in the bodies below their level, the vice president is permitted to take part in faculty-level funding rounds.
The vice president is responsible for degree programmes and holds a higher office, which permits participation in subordinate working groups.
As a holder of a higher office responsible for the quality of teaching, the vice president may take part in lower-level decisions regarding teaching laboratories.
Because those with a higher office may take part in the bodies and rounds below their level, the vice president is permitted to participate.
